# Root directories the eks-agent-platform tree authors, one per line.
#
# A SNAPSHOT of another repository, committed here so the check that reads it runs
# everywhere rather than only where a checkout happens to exist. A test that skips when
# its authority is unresolvable prints its skip into a green job, and nobody reads a
# green job — so on a runner, which never has a checkout, it asserted nothing at all.
#
# Not a second source of truth: TestAgentPlatformRoots_SnapshotMatchesARealCheckout
# compares this file against a real tree wherever one resolves, so the cache cannot
# drift unnoticed. Regenerate with:
#
#   go test ./internal/phases -run SnapshotMatchesARealCheckout -update \
#     -args -checkout=/path/to/eks-agent-platform
#
# Every entry holds a terragrunt.hcl. A name rackctl applies with no root here aborts
# the phase before it applies ANYTHING, and a dry run still looks fine.
